order.subject: science
order.topic: Chemical reactions and conservation of mass
order.requests: Follow my lesson notes. I never want a key or explanation that says mass disappears or that gas has no mass. Use the counting table I use for atoms.

itemRequests.notes: Fill-in blanks like my old notes, with a word bank and a Stop and think box per section.
itemRequests.slides: One slide per big idea, plus a closed vs. open flask slide. Speaker notes should tell me what to ask the class.
itemRequests.quiz: 10 questions, my Know it / Use it / Explain it parts. At least one balancing question and one open vs. closed mass problem. Include a picture with no answer labels.
